questions.question: What did Ezekiel see departing in chapter 10?
options: The ark of the covenant being carried away into the exile
A great and mighty army descending all around upon the city
A wide river of fire flowing out from the foot of the altar
The glory of the LORD leaving the threshold of the temple
questions.answer: The glory of the LORD leaving the threshold of the temple
